# v1.3.0 — Account rework, Chapter Milestones & rank titles

## What changed

- **A brand-new Account page.** The old wall of stacked panels is gone. Account
  now opens with a **hero header** showing your current rank, chapters read and
  day streak, with a progress bar toward your next milestone. Everything below
  is grouped into clean, **collapsible sections** so the page stays short and
  scannable.
- **Chapter Milestones.** Nine lifetime tiers (1, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500,
  1000, 2500 chapters) turn your reading into badges. Unlocked tiers light up;
  locked ones show how far you have to go. Your current tier is highlighted.
- **Choose your title naming.** Rank names adapt to the genre you love. Pick
  from **Classic, Murim, Fantasy, Knight, Mage, Cultivation** or **Hunter** —
  so 500 chapters reads as "Sage" in Classic, "Grandmaster" in Murim, "A-Rank"
  in Hunter, and so on.
- **Goals.** Set a **chapter-count goal** and a **weekly goal**, each with its
  own progress bar. Goals are saved on your device and update as you read.
- **Streak badges.** Consecutive-day reading streaks now unlock badges at 3, 7,
  14, 30 and 100 days.
- **Richer stats.** The Reading Stats panel now shows a **14-day activity
  sparkline**, plus **top sources** and **top genres** as ranked bars, and an
  in-progress / completed summary.

## Fixes

- Account buttons are consistent again: they no longer use near-black fills that
  clashed with the theme, they meet a comfortable tap-target size, and their
  labels are no longer forced to uppercase. Dark, Light and App Store themes all
  share the same clean styling.
- Account panels no longer inherit the reader's bottom-sheet sizing (which had
  capped them at 500px wide with their own scrollbar), so cards now size to
  their content.

## Under the hood

- New pure module `public/js/milestones.js` computes tiers, ranks, streaks and
  goal progress. Everything is **derived** from the existing `chapter_reads`
  log — no new database tables.
- `/api/user/stats` gained a `dailyReads` series (last 14 days) to power the
  sparkline.
- Added a milestones unit test and an account-rework guard test.
